label: fastaf CLI
text:
Capabilities: Open files and URLs as tabs, create/list/write/read PTY sessions and query repository status from scripts.

Install when automation needs the fastaf command. A missing or mismatched CLI can make scripts fail.

label: Code intelligence · MDKB
text:
When to change: Manage it when you need indexed navigation or memory.

If wrong: Without an available index, those lookups are unavailable.

Default: Read the installed host state.

label: Custom launchers
text:
When to change: Add one for an editor or tool not offered by discovery.

If wrong: A wrong executable or argument opens the wrong target or fails to launch.

Default: No custom launchers.

label: When closing the main window
text:
When to change: Use Background to keep work running after closing visible windows.

If wrong: Choosing Quit can end live sessions; Ask gives you a choice first.

Default: "ask".

label: Tray and menu-bar icon
text:
When to change: Choose Always for a persistent Show/Quit entry point.

If wrong: Do not interpret Never as disabling background execution.

Default: "background_only".

label: Prevent sleep when busy
text:
When to change: Enable for long work that must continue without sleep.

If wrong: It can use more power; with it off, normal system sleep may interrupt work.

Default: false.

label: Auto-Standby Timeout
text:
When to change: Increase it if background terminals must stay runnable longer.

If wrong: A short timeout pauses idle background work sooner; disabling it uses more resources.

Default: 5.

label: Content Indexing
text:
When to change: Reduce indexing when startup or background resource use is too high.

If wrong: Disabled background indexing can delay later searches; all-repository warming uses more resources.

Default: "active_and_switch".

label: Wait for agents before restarting
text:
When to change: Keep on to avoid disrupting an active turn.

If wrong: Turning it off can restart the app before agents are ready.

Default: true.

label: Resume all agents after an update
text:
When to change: Disable if you prefer to resume tabs only when needed.

If wrong: With it on, many eligible agents can restart; unconfirmed sessions are not invented.

Default: true.

label: Update Channel
text:
When to change: Use Beta or Nightly only when you want prerelease changes.

If wrong: A prerelease channel can install less-tested behavior; Stable does not receive every preview.

Default: "stable".

label: Cycle All Tab Types
text:
When to change: Enable if keyboard navigation should reach non-terminal tabs too.

If wrong: With it off those shortcuts cycle terminals only.

Default: false.

label: Nested Terminal Tabs
text:
When to change: Enable when you want to navigate a branch’s existing sessions directly.

If wrong: With it off nested rows disappear; it does not start or discover extra agents.

Default: false.

label: Mute Intermediate Text
text:
When to change: Disable when all assistant text should have equal emphasis.

If wrong: With it on, intermediate explanations are easier to overlook, but Copy and Find still include them.

Default: true.

label: Audio Output Device
text:
Enumeration starts only after Choose output device. On macOS, the audio scan can cause a microphone-permission prompt even though notifications never record audio.

Default: system output. Choosing a disconnected output can make alerts inaudible.

label: Orchestration
text:
When to change: Leave it on for multi-agent batches; turn it off to hear worker completions.

If wrong: Turning it off can create a burst of completion sounds.

Default: true.

label: Toolbar Bell
text:
When to change: Turn it off only if you prefer temporary user-action feedback.

If wrong: A dismissed ordinary toast can be harder to recover; direct agent notices remain in the bell.

Default: true.

label: Show cards from the active terminal
text:
When to change: Disable to keep transient cards urgent-only on this client.

If wrong: Turning it off makes ordinary agent messages less immediately visible.

Default: On, per client.

label: OS notifications for Tasks
text:
When to change: Enable when you need native task alerts; follow the tasks whose comments matter.

If wrong: Unfollowed or unrefreshed items do not notify; this does not add background polling.

Default: Off.

label: Shell
text:
When to change: Override only when another installed shell is needed.

If wrong: A missing executable prevents a new terminal from starting.

Default: Inherited.

label: Default Font Size
text:
When to change: Increase for readability or decrease to fit more output.

If wrong: Too small is hard to read; too large leaves fewer terminal cells.

Default: 13.

label: Copy on select
text:
When to change: Disable when selection should not overwrite clipboard content.

If wrong: With it on, selecting text replaces the clipboard; with it off, copy explicitly.

Default: true.

label: Allow OSC 52 clipboard writes
text:
When to change: Keep on for remote copy workflows, or disable to ignore output-driven clipboard writes.

If wrong: A displayed log or file can also overwrite the clipboard when enabled.

Default: true.

label: Block folding
text:
When to change: Disable if folding interferes with reading full command output.

If wrong: Collapsed output can be overlooked; turning off does not expand already folded blocks.

Default: true.

label: Show scrollbar marks
text:
When to change: Disable if history marks clutter the scrollbar.

If wrong: Without marks, command boundaries are harder to locate in long scrollback.

Default: true.

label: Reflow scrollback on resize
text:
When to change: Keep enabled to read old output after opening a side panel; disable to preserve original line layout.

If wrong: Without reflow, historical lines can be truncated at a narrower width.

Default: true.

label: Global Hotkey (Toggle Window)
text:
When to change: Change when the current combination conflicts with another application.

If wrong: An OS shortcut conflict can make the window toggle unavailable.

label: Plugin Commands
text:
When to change: Set a shortcut for a plugin action you use often.

If wrong: An unloaded plugin cannot supply its action; a conflicting key can invoke another command.

Default: Plugin-provided binding or unassigned.

label: GitHub account
text:
When to change: Sign in when GitHub operations lack an appropriate account.

If wrong: A saved credential is not proof of a current connection or permission to a private repository.

Default: Read-only account state, not a preference default.

label: Repository bindings
text:
When to change: Bind explicitly when multiple accounts have different access.

If wrong: A wrong binding can fail repository requests or use the wrong identity.

Default: Automatic account selection when unbound.

label: CircleCI token
text:
When to change: Set it when CircleCI logs are needed.

If wrong: An invalid token prevents log retrieval.

Default: No saved token.

label: Auto-Delete on PR Close
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different auto-delete on pr close policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: "off".

label: Copy ignored files
text:
When to change: Enable for local files needed by the new worktree.

If wrong: It can copy unwanted local data or large ignored directories.

Default: false.

label: Copy untracked files
text:
When to change: Enable when local uncommitted files are needed in the worktree.

If wrong: It can propagate files you did not intend to copy.

Default: false.

label: Default Setup Script
text:
When to change: Use it for dependencies or other repeatable setup.

If wrong: A wrong script can fail setup or modify the new checkout unexpectedly.

Default: "".

label: Default Run Script
text:
When to change: Change this when the described default run script behavior does not match your workflow.

If wrong: An incorrect script can fail the operation or execute unintended commands.

Default: "".

label: Default Archive Script
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different default archive script policy.

If wrong: An incorrect script can fail the operation or execute unintended commands.

Default: "".

label: Storage Strategy
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different storage strategy policy.

If wrong: A different location changes where worktrees are created; existing worktrees are not moved.

Default: "sibling".

label: Delete local branch when removing worktree
text:
When to change: Disable if you want to keep branches after worktree removal.

If wrong: Branch removal can make later branch reuse inconvenient; existing safeguards still apply.

Default: true.

label: Auto-archive merged worktrees
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different auto-archive merged worktrees policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: false.

label: Orphan Worktree Cleanup
text:
When to change: Change this when the described orphan worktree cleanup behavior does not match your workflow.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: "ask".

label: Safe orphan cleanup countdown
text:
When to change: Change this when the described safe orphan cleanup countdown behavior does not match your workflow.

If wrong: An unsuitable selection changes the displayed behavior, not the underlying Git data.

Default: 10.

label: PR Merge Strategy
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different pr merge strategy policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: "squash".

label: After Merge Behavior
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different after merge behavior policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: "archive".

label: Auto-Fetch Interval
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different auto-fetch interval policy.

If wrong: A short interval creates more Git/network work; disabling fetch can leave upstream information stale.

Default: 0.

label: Add Enterprise account
text:
When to change: Use it for repositories on your Enterprise host.

If wrong: A wrong host or token prevents account verification.

Default: No Enterprise account.

label: Codex
text:
When to change: Expand to review the editable command, arguments and bypass warning.

If wrong: A configured approval bypass affects new launches; availability does not prove sign-in.

Default: Host-discovered state; no fixed availability default.

label: ego · terminal CLI
text:
When to change: Use this page for PTY launch settings.

If wrong: Changing PTY options does not configure AI Chat access.

Default: Host-discovered state.

label: Name, command and model
text:
When to change: Create a configuration for a repeatable launch task and save it explicitly.

If wrong: Wrong commands or arguments can prevent launch; a model alias does not prove entitlement.

Default: Agent-specific default run configuration.

label: Environment variables
text:
When to change: Add only variables required by that executable or profile.

If wrong: Duplicate keys are rejected; wrong values can select an unintended configuration.

Default: No per-configuration overrides unless configured.

label: Launch instructions
text:
When to change: Edit when you need a different launch instruction contract.

If wrong: Removing required markers can hide intent or follow-up actions; empty disables injection.

Default: Inherited.

label: MCP integrations and hooks
text:
When to change: Install missing integrations only for the CLI you use.

If wrong: Missing signals can reduce state detection; unsupported integrations cannot be installed.

Default: Native status signals on for supported Claude/Codex; global hook installation off.

label: Close idle managed child after
text:
When to change: Increase the time when follow-up work is likely.

If wrong: A short time closes eligible children sooner; unread mail or background work keeps them open.

Default: 15.

label: Configure agents on
text:
When to change: Switch before changing agents on a different host.

If wrong: Editing the wrong machine changes the wrong launch configuration.

Default: Current local machine unless a remote is selected.

label: Collect project progress
text:
When to change: Change this when the described collect project progress behavior does not match your workflow.

If wrong: An unsuitable selection changes the displayed behavior, not the underlying Git data.

Default: true.

label: Launch instructions
text:
When to change: Edit when you need a different launch instruction contract.

If wrong: Removing required markers can hide intent or follow-up actions; empty disables injection.

Default: Inherited.

label: Permissions
text:
When to change: Choose a mode only when you need a launch-specific approval policy.

If wrong: Approval policy does not prove filesystem isolation or change an already running process.

Default: Inherited.

label: Filesystem sandbox
text:
When to change: Set it only when the next run needs a different confinement mode.

If wrong: The wrong mode can block required file access or leave execution less confined; it is not an approval mode.

Default: Inherited.

label: Hibernate idle agents after
text:
When to change: Increase when agents should remain live longer.

If wrong: An eligible idle tab can stop sooner; unverifiable sessions and pending work remain live.

Default: 60.

label: Hibernate scope
text:
When to change: Use always only if foreground idle tabs should also release resources.

If wrong: An idle visible agent can hibernate with always.

Default: "background_only".

label: Whisper models
text:
When to change: Download a larger model for accuracy or a smaller one for lower resource use.

If wrong: A missing model prevents transcription; larger models consume more memory and storage.

Default: large-v3-turbo is recommended and selected by default.

label: Pocket TTS voices
text:
When to change: Download a bundle for local spoken replies in that language.

If wrong: Missing assets prevent Pocket replies for that language.

Default: No universal installed-asset state; bundles depend on downloads.

label: Test recording
text:
When to change: Use it to adjust speech gates and check the microphone.

If wrong: Denied microphone permission or an unsuitable input can produce no recording.

Default: Not recording until explicitly started.

label: Auto-send
text:
When to change: Turn it off to review transcription before sending.

If wrong: With it on, a recognition mistake can be submitted before review.

Default: true.

label: Input device
text:
When to change: Choose another microphone if the system input is unsuitable.

If wrong: The wrong input captures silence or unrelated audio.

Default: Inherited.

label: Language
text:
When to change: Set an explicit language when recognition chooses the wrong one.

If wrong: A wrong language reduces recognition accuracy; languages without a voice bundle cannot use local spoken replies.

Default: "auto".

label: Level gate
text:
When to change: Raise above room noise or lower when quiet speech is rejected.

If wrong: Too high loses quiet speech; too low can transcribe noise.

Default: 0.0010000000474974513.

label: Speech confidence gate
text:
When to change: Lower for stricter rejection; 100% disables this gate.

If wrong: Too strict discards real words; too permissive admits hallucinated speech.

Default: 0.6000000238418579.

label: Speech engine
text:
When to change: Use Pocket for offline speech or External for your own engine.

If wrong: Edge requires network access and sends reply text to Microsoft; Pocket requires assets.

Default: "".

label: Speech command
text:
When to change: Configure it only when External command is selected.

If wrong: An invalid program or arguments prevent replies from being spoken.

Default: [].

label: Activation phrase
text:
When to change: Set one to avoid sending unrelated room speech.

If wrong: An empty phrase sends every recognized utterance; an unrecognized phrase drops the turn.

Default: "".

label: Hold-back before sending
text:
When to change: Increase when you need more review time.

If wrong: Too short leaves less time to stop a mistake; activation phrases impose at least five seconds.

Default: 1500.

label: Hands-free listening
text:
When to change: Turn it off when you want spoken replies without an open microphone.

If wrong: With it on, speech is captured for the bound terminal, not whichever tab later has focus.

Default: true.

label: Notify model when hands-free changes
text:
When to change: Disable only if the model must not receive mode notices.

If wrong: Without the notice, the model may not know it can answer aloud; stopping still revokes speech.

Default: true.

label: Start notice
text:
When to change: Customize when the model needs different spoken-response instructions.

If wrong: Misleading instructions can change its response style; line breaks become spaces.

Default: "".

label: Title, category and prompt template
text:
When to change: Customize a built-in or create a named action.

If wrong: Misspelled variables cannot supply the expected context.

Default: Prompt-specific shipped values or a new empty custom draft.

label: Placement and execution
text:
When to change: Match the mode to whether you need an interactive agent or a direct operation.

If wrong: Shell mode executes code rather than asking an agent; the wrong mode changes the effect.

Default: Inject for a new prompt; placements belong to the prompt.

label: Agent override and auto-execute
text:
When to change: Disable auto-execute when you need to review the resolved text first.

If wrong: The wrong agent or immediate execution can run a prompt before review.

Default: Prompt-specific values; otherwise use the headless-agent preference.

label: Content *
text:
When to change: Edit when the instructions or operation need to change.

If wrong: Shell mode runs this as code; incorrect variables can supply the wrong context.

Default: Prompt-specific template or empty new draft.

label: Execution Mode
text:
When to change: Use injection for an interactive agent and shell only for a program you intend to execute.

If wrong: Choosing shell runs the content as code without an agent interpreting it.

Default: Inject for a new prompt.

label: Target
text:
When to change: Change when the prompt belongs to another available target.

If wrong: The wrong target can receive unintended instructions.

Default: Editor-selected target; source does not specify a universal default.

label: Auto-execute
text:
Off leaves the resolved text editable and does not require the agent to be idle. On submits once through the agent-aware path with the idle check. Explicit Insert & Run and double-click still submit once regardless of this saved switch.

Default: prompt-specific; review before enabling for an unfamiliar template.

label: Preferred Agent
text:
When to change: Choose one only when this action requires a particular CLI.

If wrong: A missing or unavailable agent prevents execution.

Default: Inherit the selected headless agent.

label: Output Target
text:
When to change: Change when the result belongs somewhere other than the current output destination.

If wrong: Clipboard output can replace clipboard content; transient output can be missed.

Default: Prompt-specific editor value; no universal default verified.

label: Headless Agent
text:
When to change: Choose an installed agent before using headless execution.

If wrong: A missing agent cannot run the prompt; individual prompts can override this choice.

Default: Inherited.

label: MCP Connection
text:
When to change: Copy the manual configuration only for a client that is not auto-configured.

If wrong: An incorrect bridge path prevents the client from connecting.

Default: Host-generated bridge path, not a fixed preference.

label: Collapse tools — Speakeasy MCP (reduces AI context ~98%)
text:
When to change: Enable for clients that support lazy tool discovery and need less baseline context.

If wrong: Clients that ignore tool-list changes may need to reconnect; tool actions themselves do not change.

Default: false.

label: Capabilities
text:
When to change: Disable a capability when agents should not use that domain or action group.

If wrong: Denied actions disappear from discovery and cannot be called. Additional restrictions preserve migrated denials; a parent denial also blocks its grouped actions.

Default: Settings access and Diagnostics / JS inspection are denied.

label: Upstreams on
text:
When to change: Switch before editing an upstream on a remote host.

If wrong: The wrong host selection changes another machine rather than this one.

Default: Local machine unless a connected remote is selected.

label: Authentication
text:
When to change: Use the method required by its server.

If wrong: Wrong authentication makes requests fail; sign-in state is not a successful tool call.

Default: Bearer is the initial HTTP editor method.

label: Timeout (s):
text:
When to change: Increase only for tools that legitimately need longer to finish.

If wrong: Too short fails slow calls; 0 can leave a mute tool waiting indefinitely.

Default: 30.

label: URL
text:
When to change: Use the endpoint supplied by the server operator.

If wrong: A wrong path fails connection; a different credential origin requires a new upstream.

label: Bearer token
text:
When to change: Replace when the server rotates or revokes it.

If wrong: An invalid token prevents authentication; stored values are not read back.

label: Client Secret
text:
When to change: Leave it unset for public clients that do not use a secret.

If wrong: A wrong secret makes token exchange fail; it must not be exposed as plain diagnostic text.

label: Scopes
text:
When to change: Change only when the server requires different permissions.

If wrong: Missing scopes can deny tools; excess scopes ask for unnecessary access.

Default: [].

label: Command
text:
When to change: Use the installed server command, not an HTTP URL.

If wrong: A missing command cannot launch; the named program runs as the current user.

label: Working directory
text:
When to change: Set when the server needs project-relative files.

If wrong: A missing or wrong folder can prevent startup or select the wrong project.

Default: Inherited.

label: Tailscale HTTPS
text:
When to change: Recheck after Tailscale or its certificate setup changes.

If wrong: Without a usable HTTPS address, remote push registration may not work.

Default: Runtime status, read from this machine.

label: Regenerate remote token
text:
When to change: Use when you need to revoke existing device access.

If wrong: Previously shared token URLs and active sessions stop working.

Default: Action, not a persistent value; requires explicit confirmation.

label: Password
text:
When to change: Replace when rotating remote login access.

If wrong: A wrong password prevents login; an empty editor must not be mistaken for a readable saved secret.

label: Network Interface
text:
When to change: Use loopback for this host only or reachable interfaces for other devices.

If wrong: Loopback-only blocks other devices; the wrong interface can leave the desired address unreachable.

Default: Saved interface.

label: Session Token Duration
text:
When to change: Shorten to require more frequent reauthentication on unused devices.

If wrong: Too short interrupts occasional clients; a longer duration keeps unused logins valid longer.

Default: 2592000.

label: Enable IPv6 (dual-stack)
text:
When to change: Enable when remote clients need IPv6; save and restart the server.

If wrong: Changing without the required restart leaves the old listener configuration active.

Default: false.

label: Enable cloud relay
text:
When to change: Enable only when you need relay-based access.

If wrong: A wrong endpoint or bearer token prevents connection; the relay remains a trusted operator.

Default: false.

label: Bearer Token
text:
When to change: Replace when registering or rotating relay access.

If wrong: A wrong token prevents relay authentication; it does not provide end-to-end secrecy.

label: Deployment and lifetime
text:
When to change: Enable deployment or updates only for the daemon you intend to manage.

If wrong: The wrong lifetime can stop an unattended daemon; updates wait for no live PTY sessions.

Default: Deploy never; survive 1800 seconds; auto-update off.

label: SSH discovery
text:
When to change: Use a discovered host as a starting point for a connection.

If wrong: Discovery does not establish a successful login or a running daemon.

Default: Read-only discovery; no host is probed.

label: User
text:
When to change: Choose the account that owns the daemon and repositories.

If wrong: A wrong user can fail login or select another home directory.

Default: Host-specific SSH configuration; no account default verified.

label: Polling owner
text:
When to change: Reload when pairing is unavailable or another owner may have taken over.

If wrong: No active poller means Link chat cannot accept a pairing message.

label: Bot token
text:
When to change: Replace when configuring a bot or rotating its token.

If wrong: An invalid token prevents Telegram polling; it is never read back into Settings.

Default: No token configured.

label: Authorized chats
text:
When to change: Link only chats that should communicate with registered agents.

If wrong: An unlinked chat cannot send agent messages; removing a chat revokes that access.

Default: No authorized chats.

label: Registered agent
text:
When to change: Ask the desired agent to register when none is shown.

If wrong: A configured bot alone does not choose a recipient agent.

Default: No agent registered until it opts in.

label: Bot token
text:
When to change: Replace when configuring a bot or rotating its token.

If wrong: An invalid token prevents Telegram polling; it is never read back into Settings.

Default: No token configured.

label: Authorized chats
text:
When to change: Link only chats that should communicate with registered agents.

If wrong: An unlinked chat cannot send agent messages; removing a chat revokes that access.

Default: No authorized chats.

label: Local install
text:
When to change: Use it for a plugin not installed through the registry.

If wrong: A wrong package can fail to load; browser clients cannot use native file installation.

Default: No local plugin selected.

label: Account
text:
When to change: Choose an identity with access to the intended projects.

If wrong: A saved sign-in is not proof of live access or entitlement.

Default: No account selected.

label: Account
text:
When to change: Choose an identity with access to the intended projects.

If wrong: A saved sign-in is not proof of live access or entitlement.

Default: No account selected.

label: Account
text:
When to change: Choose an identity with access to the intended projects.

If wrong: A saved sign-in is not proof of live access or entitlement.

Default: No account selected.

label: Effective defaults
text:
When to change: Review the source before changing an override.

If wrong: A team .tuic.json value takes priority over a per-repository app value.

Default: Inherit global defaults unless a higher-priority source supplies a value.

label: Share with team
text:
When to change: Use when teammates need the same supported repository defaults.

If wrong: Exporting the wrong overrides changes shared behavior; review the resulting file.

Default: Action; no export until requested.

label: Reset repository overrides
text:
When to change: Reset when the repository should follow common defaults again.

If wrong: Customized repository behavior is lost; team-file precedence remains.

Default: Action with scoped confirmation.

label: File Handling
text:
When to change: Override when this repository needs different local setup files.

If wrong: Copying unwanted local files can propagate data or large directories.

Default: Inherit global copy flags; both global defaults are off.

label: Orphan Worktree Cleanup
text:
When to change: Change this when the described orphan worktree cleanup behavior does not match your workflow.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: PR Merge Strategy
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different pr merge strategy policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: After Merge Behavior
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different after merge behavior policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: Auto-Delete on PR Close
text:
When to change: Change this when this repository workflow needs a different auto-delete on pr close policy.

If wrong: An unsuitable cleanup or merge choice can remove local branches or archive a worktree earlier than intended; preserve the existing confirmation and safety checks.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: Dev Server URL
text:
When to change: Change this when the described dev server url behavior does not match your workflow.

If wrong: An unsuitable selection changes the displayed behavior, not the underlying Git data.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: Setup Script
text:
When to change: Use it for repository-specific setup.

If wrong: A failing or incorrect script can leave setup incomplete.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: Run Script
text:
When to change: Set it for a repeatable development command.

If wrong: A wrong script starts the wrong command in the repository.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.

label: Archive Script
text:
When to change: Use it when cleanup is required before removal.

If wrong: A failing script prevents archive or deletion; an incorrect successful script can modify files.

Default: Inherit the global value unless overridden; a team .tuic.json value has higher priority.
